warmup: Dr. Nair here. Before we touch those trophies, squeeze a bottle. Put the cap on, then drag down on the bottle. Feel that push back? Now take the cap off and squeeze again. Watch your squeeze log fill in, and ask: what was pushing?
part1: Time to test, not guess. Tap the rock to send it into the machine. Gate one asks: does it have mass? Gate two: does it take up space? Pick your proof at each gate. The shadow and the bell might surprise you. Fill both trays.
explore: The real test. Put Trophy A on the balance and read the screen. Then hold it under the water with the rod, and read how far the water climbs. Do both trophies. When both property cards are full, compare them. Same space, different mass. What does that mean?
evidence: A classmate says air takes up no space because you can’t see it. You tested that today! Pick your side, tap two facts in the planner, then write your reasoning. Claim, evidence, reasoning. That’s your C-E-R.
